correctness.rationale: Read the exact all-dimensional RESULT.md proof and verify.py. The no-jump generator L=iJA-kappa e1e1*/2 is Hurwitz: Re eigenvalue=-kappa|v1|²/(2||v||²) and v1=0 forces zero all coordinates by path recurrence. Therefore Q=int_0^infinity exp(L*t) exp(Lt) dt is unique positive Hermitian Lyapunov solution L*Q+QL=-I. For i<=j the proposed Qij=(N+1-j)(i/kappa+(i-1)kappa/(4J²)) if even separation, otherwise -i(N+1-j)/(2J); adjacent bulk affine cancellation and first-site sink boundary cancel every off-diagonal residual, diagonal residual -1. Boundary conventions b_(N+1)=0 complete the proof. For site m the diagonal mean is (N+1-m)(m/kappa+(m-1)kappa/(4J²)); convexity uniquely optimizes at 2J sqrt(m/(m-1)) for m>=2, m1 has no finite optimizer. Fresh independent exact SymPy rational calculations verified the full Lyapunov equality for 24 distinct (N,J,kappa) cases and all tested optima. Finite tests support, not prove, all N.
